top_signals.title: Treasuries Slide as Hot US Inflation Cements December Rate Bets
top_signals.summary: Treasuries sank and traders solidified their bets that Federal Reserve officials will raise interest rates when they next meet in December after evidence of persistently hot US inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
top_signals.summary: The report comes at a critical juncture for the Federal Reserve as it considers its next move regarding interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Vanguard Inks $4 Billion of Private Debt to Fund Altruist Deal
top_signals.summary: Vanguard Group has raised about $4 billion of private debt to finance its acquisition of digital wealth platform Altruist.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
top_signals.summary: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: eToro’s Q3 profit plunges 74% as weaker crypto trading weighs on earnings
top_signals.summary: eToro reported a 74% decline in Q3 profit to $15 million, with weaker crypto activity weighing on earnings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Clubs may need £40m in liquid assets to satisfy Independent Football Regulator
top_signals.summary: Clubs could be required to hold more than £40m in liquid assets in order to be granted a licence to continue competing by the Independent Football Regulator (IFR).
